u: This man page only documents the hardware-specific features of the etapro driver. For information about the core driver, see nutupsdrv(8).
This driver supports ETA UPS equipment with the "PRO" option for smart mode.
This driver does not support any extra settings in the ups.conf(5).

The core driver:

nutupsdrv(8)
